name: strat-clone-engine
description: Strat-Clone Engine - Multi-tenant automated trading SaaS

scripts.dev: concurrently "npm run dev:server" "npm run dev:web" "npm run dev:worker"
scripts.build: npm run build --prefix web && npm run build --prefix server
scripts.start: concurrently "npm run start --prefix server" "npm run start --prefix web"
scripts.install:all: npm install && npm install --prefix web && npm install --prefix server && npm install --prefix worker
